item.title: Reps pass FCT rent regulation bill amid disagreement
item.description: Lawmakers divided over proposed ban on compulsory multi-year rent payments By Gift Chapi Odekina, Abuja The House of Representatives has passed for second reading a bill seeking to regulate rental payments and curb exploitative practices by landlords and estate agents in the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), amid disagreements among lawmakers over a proposed ban on compulsory multi-year rent payments. The bill, sponsored by Rep. Paul Sunday Nnamchi, seeks to regulate advance rent payments, arbitrary rent increases and agency fees, as well as establish a unified digital register for housing agents. It also provides safeguards for landlords and tenants, with penalties for violations of its provisions. Leading the debate, Nnamchi said the rising cost of accommodation and excessive demands for advance rent had placed enormous financial pressure on residents, affecting household savings, small businesses and employment mobility. He said the proposed legislation was designed to establish a fairer and more accountable rental system through the regulation of advance payments, reasonable limits on agency fees and proper identification of housing agents. “Mr Speaker, this legislation is not intended to undermine property rights or discourage investment. Rather, it recognises that legitimate commercial interests must coexist with public protection. Landlords deserve reasonable returns. “Agents deserve professional recognition. And tenants deserve fairness and protection from exploitation,” he said. Supporting the bill, Rep. Idris Zacharias, representing Ida/Igalamela/Ibaji/Ofu Federal Constituency of Kogi State, described the proposal as important but called for broader consideration of land administration and housing challenges in the FCT. He also urged the House Committee on FCT and Area Councils to be included in the committee that would consider the bill. Similarly, Rep. Chinedu Ogah, representing Ikwo/Ezza South Federal Constituency of Ebonyi State, backed the proposal, citing the difficulties businesses face in securing office accommodation in Abuja. Ogah said renting a three-bedroom office in Wuse could cost between N25 million and N30 million annually, excluding additional agency charges. He argued that regulating the rental market would provide clearer rules for transactions and encourage investment in the sector. However, Rep. Leko Jafaru Gambo, representing Bogoro/Dass/Tafawa Balewa Federal Constituency of Bauchi State, called for a review of the bill’s title, arguing that the word “prohibit” should be replaced with “regulate”. He also suggested that the legislation should have nationwide application, but Deputy Speaker Benjamin Kalu clarified that its current scope was limited to the FCT. Rep. Ibe Okwara Osonwa, representing Arochukwu/Ohafia Federal Constituency of Abia State, also supported regulation but cautioned against an outright prohibition of multi-year rent arrangements. item.title: Big 12 Conference taking executive action to fix officiating after 2 screwups at BYU games
item.description: Rob Gray-Imagn Images Big 12 Conference taking executive action to fix officiating after 2 screwups at BYU games appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Big 12 keeps having officiating mistakes. In the BYU win over Arizona State, another officiating mistake occurred, and the Big 12 conference was forced to admit another misstep . Now, the conference is doing a deeper look into its officiating , per Jon Wilner of KSL News. “Per source close to the Big 12: Executive meeting this week w anyone involved in officiating (on-field, replay booth, command center, etc). Entire operation will be evaluated. Conference has had issues with application of the rules/officiating mechanics 3 weeks in a row,” Wilner posted on X, formerly Twitter. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) The first mistake came in the October 17 game between BYU and Notre Dame . Notre Dame was driving late in the fourth quarter, down four against BYU. A pass from CJ Carr fell incomplete, ending the game. Still, there should have been a second left on the clock, which would have allowed Notre Dame another chance for the game-winning touchdown. Then, on October 24, with UCF hosting, BYU officials enforced a ten-second run off at the end of regulation. The runoff was incorrectly applied, and UCF should have had a chance to win the game in regulation. The Knights would go on to win the game in overtime. This past week, BYU faced off against Arizona State. In the first quarter on a second-and-goal play from the one-yard line, Bear Bachmeier attempted to stretch into the end zone, but fumbled before crossing the goal line. The ball was recovered at the two-yard line by Sione Moa, who advanced the ball into the end zone for a touchdown. The ball should not have been allowed to be advanced, though, and the ball should have been awarded to BYU for a third-down attempt. While mistakes happen in officiating, three weeks in a row is something that needs to be reviewed. Related: Iowa’s Kirk Ferentz shades ESPN for bias before first CFP rankings reveal Related: ‘College GameDay’ Halloween broadcast maintains historic viewership streak

item.title: Google gives Nigerian health-tech firm $2.5m for maternal care AI
item.description: Project targets 1.9m women in four states By Juliet Umeh Google has awarded Nigerian health technology company, Helium Health, a $2.5 million (about N3.4 billion) grant to deploy artificial intelligence (AI) tools aimed at improving maternal healthcare in Nigeria. The company was the only Nigerian organisation among 15 global recipients selected for the $30 million Google.org Impact Challenge: AI for Government Innovation, an initiative supporting organisations using technology to improve public services in partnership with governments. The Nigerian project was unveiled in Lagos during an executive briefing with Governor Babajide Sanwo-Olu, led by executives of Google and Helium Health. The initiative will be implemented in Lagos, Delta, Kano and Oyo states, with Lagos serving as its primary launchpad. The selected organisations will also participate in a Google.org accelerator programme, where they will receive technical support from Google engineers and artificial intelligence product experts. Speaking on the grant, Helium Health Chief Executive Officer, Dimeji Sofowora, said the company had spent the past decade developing technology and partnerships to improve healthcare delivery across Africa. He said its maternal health initiatives had already reached more than 3.5 million women, adding that the Google.org support would enable the company to expand its interventions and extend access to quality maternal healthcare. “Through our maternal health initiatives, we’ve already reached over 3.5 million women, and Google.org’s support gives us an opportunity to build on that foundation, scale what works, and reach even more women with quality maternal healthcare,” he said. The company’s Head of Public Health, Dr Shona Oluwatola, said the project aims to reach an additional 1.9 million women over three years and contribute to a 30 per cent reduction in maternal mortality. She noted that Nigeria accounts for nearly three in every 10 maternal deaths globally, stressing the need for interventions that would help women identify pregnancy-related risks early and access timely medical attention. “Nigeria accounts for nearly three in every 10 maternal deaths globally. Behind every maternal death is a woman whose family expected her to come home,” Oluwatola said. “Our goal is to reach an additional 1.9 million women over three years and contribute to a 30 per cent reduction in maternal mortality,” she added. The project will deploy Helium Health’s HeliumMum platform to help pregnant women identify potential health risks early and access appropriate medical care. The platform will connect pregnant women with healthcare providers through electronic medical records and AI-powered clinical decision-support tools, while providing governments with data to guide maternal health policies and service delivery. item.title: Kevin Durant names his all-time greatest NBA starting five
item.description: Photo by Slaven Vlasic/Getty Images Kevin Durant made some bold choices while picking his all-time starting five in the NBA The two-time NBA champion was on The Mount Rushmore podcast with Shaquille O’Neal and spoke about various things, including how the LA Lakers legend would fit in the current NBA. Currently playing in his 20th NBA season, Durant has all the laurels to be recognised as an all-time great. He is regarded by many as one of the greatest scorers in the game, and because of this, the 38-year-old decided to pick himself for his all-time starting lineup. “I’m going to go with LeBron at my point. Since you (Shaq) picked Kobe, I’m going Tracy McGrady at my two guard,” said Durant on The Mount Rushmore podcast. “I’m going to go three and I’m going KG (Kevin Garnett) at the four.” The discussion then came down to the centre position and there was some confusion as the initial rules dictated that Durant was not allowed to pick O’Neal in his lineup. However, Shaq then came up with a solution, which was a direct trade of the centres. This meant that KD’s starting lineup now had LeBron James, Tracy McGrady, himself, Kevin Garnett and Hakeem Olajuwon. Collectively, KD’s lineup had 72 All-Star appearances, which was one less than O’Neal’s list, as the four-time NBA champion had Magic Johnson, Kobe Bryant, Michael Jordan, Karl Malone and himself in his starting five. The rules were simple: each of them had to come up with a different lineup, which is what made the segment unique. The hosts Ari Emmanuel and Ben Persky also came up with their starting fives, with some unique additions. However, fans would definitely be more inclined towards what Durant and Shaq had in mind when it came to their starting lineup. item.title: Report: Liverpool have huge Szoboszlai decision to make
item.description: Report: Liverpool have huge Szoboszlai decision to make Dominik Szoboszlai Dilemma Gives Andoni Iraola a Defining Liverpool Call Liverpool have reached an intriguing stage of the season, and one of the biggest talking points centres on Dominik Szoboszlai. A player once viewed as central to the club’s leadership group and tactical future is now facing fresh scrutiny over his place in Andoni Iraola’s side. According to the Mail, the debate has intensified after a run of matches in which Liverpool appeared to carry greater balance without the Hungary international in the starting line-up. That discussion is not without substance. Szoboszlai’s early-season standing looked beyond doubt. He had impressed through pre-season, took on a more prominent leadership role, and marked Iraola’s first competitive fixture with a decisive late goal at Newcastle. At that point, he looked every inch a foundational figure for the new head coach. Since then, the picture has changed. Injury interrupted his rhythm, Liverpool continued to pick up wins, and his return has coincided with growing questions over structure, spacing and midfield chemistry. It is a debate that cuts to the heart of how Iraola wants this team to function. Photo: IMAGO Midfield Balance at Centre of Liverpool Debate The argument against Szoboszlai, as set out in the reportby The Mail, is largely tactical. Liverpool have looked more secure when Florian Wirtz has operated ahead of midfielders willing to hold shape and do the less glamorous work behind him. In that structure, Alexis Mac Allister has found freedom to influence games more naturally, while Trey Nyoni has offered calmness in deeper areas and helped the side control transitions. There is a logic to that view. If Szoboszlai and Wirtz drift into similar zones, Liverpool can become easier to counter. That matters greatly for an Iraola side expected to press aggressively and recover the ball in advanced areas. If the spacing behind the attack is not right, the whole framework can quickly look fragile. The mention of the Arsenal game is important. The suggestion is that Liverpool lost control when Nyoni went off and Szoboszlai came on, a switch that altered the midfield dynamic rather than simply changing personnel. It points to a possible issue of fit rather than form. Why Dominik Szoboszlai Remains Too Good to Ignore Yet it would be rash to reduce the conversation to a simple choice of balance over brilliance. Szoboszlai remains one of Liverpool’s most gifted players, and the report makes clear there is still significant faith internally in what he can become over the coming years. His qualities are obvious. He offers goals from midfield, carries a real threat from distance, contributes from set plays, and brings the sort of intensity modern elite sides demand. item.title: HP Inc hires former GSK boss as CEO
item.description: HP Inc has hired former GSK boss Emma Walmsley to plot its course through choppy PC and print waters. Walmsley spent eight years as the boss at pharma biz GSK and further back in time held various marketing and general management positions at L'Oreal. She has no track record running a tech company, though she was on Microsoft’s board. “Throughout the process, Emma stood out for the strength of her leadership experience across multiple industries, the clarity of her strategic thinking and her ability to translate customer insights into new growth,” said Chip Bergh, chair of HP's board. In the first nine months of HP's fiscal 2026 , revenue had jumped 10 percent year-on-year to $44.5 billion. The print business shrank in that time and PCs generated the growth. However, amid a memory crunch with supplies dwindling, analysts are forecasting PC market contraction in terms of unit sales. Global PC shipments slumped 20 percent in Q3 as DRAM shortages forced up prices and customers opted instead to sweat their assets rather than replace their fleet of computers. Things aren't expected to improve in the final three months of 2026. One beacon of hope for all PC makers was AI, yet many customers aren't buying into the story for various reasons. Walmsley previously said that during her time at the top of GSK she created a "totally different company, in platform, in momentum, in talent, in culture," she told the FT . "I think in time… it will be recognized." She also dealt with activist investor Elliot Management, which operates in the tech industry and called for her to reapply for the CEO role at GSK, claiming her lack of science background was an issue. Walmsley said: " HP is an iconic company with a defining role in shaping the future of work on a global scale. I’m excited to join the team and, together, move forward with clarity and conviction. We will focus on harnessing the power of the AI era and putting HP’s creativity and innovation to work to unlock new sources of growth and deliver lasting value for our customers, shareholders, partners and people." Employees will be crossing their fingers that their new boss doesn’t borrow from the playbook of her predecessor - who hotfooted it to PayPal in February - by running multiple redundancy rounds, and shareholders will hope their stock price show sustainable improvement. If not, Walmsley may have to manage more interest from activist investors at the latest corporation she is running. ®

item.title: Shedeur Sanders in line to start Week 9 as Browns place Deshaun Watson in concussion protocol
item.description: Shedeur Sanders in line to start Week 9 as Browns place Deshaun Watson in concussion protocol originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Cleveland Browns have been starting Deshaun Watson at quarterback all season long, despite initial indications that he could get benched. But that was only if things were going south. Instead, the Browns are out to a strong 5-3 record. While they just lost to the Pittsburgh Steelers in Week 8, the Browns are still in good shape to make a push for the playoffs. However, Wednesday morning after Week 8, leading up to Week 9, the Browns made a huge announcement . They are placing Watson in concussion protocol, which puts his Week 9 status in doubt. That means Shedeur Sanders might finally make his first start of the year for Cleveland in Week 9 when the Browns face off against the New Orleans Saints . Browns might start Shedeur Sanders in Week 9 after Deshaun Watson news "Deshaun Watson has been placed in concussion protocol," the Browns announced Wednesday. They also shared a lengthy comment that reveals why this news comes so far after their Week 8 matchup. Watson was cleared to return to the game in Week 8 and didn't present concussion symptoms after the game. However, "On Tuesday morning, he reported to the medical staff that he began experiencing concussion symptoms Monday night and was immediately placed in the concussion protocol." Despite initially coming out of the week with no issues, Watson's symptoms came about and now have him in question for Week 9 as the Browns placed him in the concussion protocol. He could still play this weekend against the Saints, but it's likely a long shot considering how late of an add he was to the concussion protocol. MORE : Ravens' 6 best QB options to replace injured Lamar Jackson, from Jacoby Brissett to Shedeur Sanders That means Sanders, currently the team's No. 2 quarterback, is most likely to start for Cleveland and Todd Monken in Week 9. Watson has gotten the bulk of the work this season, though Sanders has come into two games, including against the Steelers this past week, when he went two-for-two for two passing yards in a very brief relief appearance for Watson. After throwing for 1,400 yards on a 56.6 completion percentage with seven touchdowns and 10 interceptions during his rookie season, Sanders lost the QB1 job to Watson in 2026. He hasn't had a chance to play this season, given how well the Browns have played. But now, with Watson in concussion protocol and not likely to suit up in Week 9 against the Saints, Sanders might finally be in line to make his first start of his second NFL season. It's a great matchup too, so this is a chance Sanders cannot squander. item.title: Browns to make Shedeur Sanders decision after unfortunate Deshaun Watson injury
item.description: The Cleveland Browns fell 27-6 to the Pittsburgh Steelers on Sunday, dropping to their third loss of the season. Deshaun Watson left the game briefly in the first quarter after a helmet-to-helmet hit from safety Jaquan Brisker, then passed his concussion evaluation and returned for Cleveland’s next series. Watson appeared to clear two more evaluations, one after the game and another Monday morning, without showing symptoms. That picture changed by Tuesday, setting up a tight decision for the Browns ahead of a key divisional-style matchup. MORE: Deshaun Watson gets unexpected Stephen A. Smith praise as Browns lead AFC North Deshaun Watson placed in concussion protocol Cleveland Browns quarterback Deshaun Watson (4). Credit: Charles LeClaire-Imagn Images. Deshaun Watson has been placed in the NFL’s concussion protocol , the Browns announced. The team said Watson told medical staff Tuesday morning that he began feeling symptoms Monday night. Watson must clear the league’s five-step return-to-play process, which ends with sign-off from both the team physician and an independent neurological consultant, before he can play again. With Deshaun Watson in concussion protocol, Browns QB Sheduer Sanders is next in line to start on Sunday’s game vs. the Saints. pic.twitter.com/Gv1fQycWJe — Adam Schefter (@AdamSchefter) November 4, 2026 With the New Orleans Saints on deck Sunday, Cleveland has limited time to get clarity on his status. Shedeur Sanders next in line if Deshaun Watson can’t clear protocol With Watson in protocol, Shedeur Sanders is next in line to start Sunday’s game against the Saints. Sanders entered Sunday’s loss for four snaps when Watson briefly left the field. Dillon Gabriel, Cleveland’s No. 3 quarterback, was activated Monday after missing the first seven games with a back injury, while rookie Taylen Green remains on the roster as a fourth option. Watson has delivered a fourth-quarter, game-winning drive in each of Cleveland’s five victories this season, making his status a central question as the Browns prepare for New Orleans. — Enjoy free coverage of the top news & trending stories with The Big Lead Newsletter —

item.title: Brewers Manager Pat Murphy breaks down hot mic comment about Jake Bauers’ former Yankees team
item.description: Milwaukee Brewers manager Pat Murphy spoke Tuesday about the Yankees remark that recently went viral, reflecting on his exchange with Jake Bauers during the club’s 2026 World Series festivities. The conversation gained traction when video showed Murphy talking with Bauers shortly after Milwaukee secured the championship against the Tampa Bay Rays. The Brewers manager later revisited the exchange on the New York Post’s “The Show” podcast, where he joined hosts Joel Sherman and Jon Heyman. Pat Murphy explains the "horses–t Yankees" comment and reveals that he called Brian Cashman to talk about it. The Show with @Joelsherman1 & @JonHeyman –> https://t.co/pCkb7MaJxk pic.twitter.com/VpsENSTDRH — New York Post Sports (@nypostsports) November 3, 2026 During the championship celebrations , Murphy took a jab at Bauers’ former team, “Just remember when you were on that horses–t Yankees team and you guys were all playing for yourself?” The comment came as Bauers was preparing to test the free-agent market after helping Milwaukee win the 2026 World Series. Pat Murphy on his viral Yankees joke with Jake Bauers Apr 28, 2026; Milwaukee, Wisconsin, USA; Brewers manager Pat Murphy (49) congratulates first baseman Jake Bauers (9) after scoring a run against the Arizona Diamondbacks in the sixth inning at American Family Field. Mandatory Credit: Michael McLoone-Imagn Images Murphy added that he reached out to Yankees general manager Brian Cashman after the audio from the exchange surfaced publicly. He characterized their discussion as friendly and positive. The conversation with Bauers took place after Milwaukee defeated Tampa Bay 4-1 in Game 5, clinching the Brewers’ first World Series title in franchise history. The Brewers manager’s exchange with Bauers was caught on a hot mic, bringing attention to his remarks about the first baseman’s time in New York. Bauers spent the 2023 season with the Yankees, making 84 appearances before the club ended the year at 82-80. Milwaukee later acquired him through a trade. Oct 28, 2026; St. Petersburg, Florida, USA; Brewers manager Pat Murphy (00) is interviewed during the trophy presentation after defeating the Tampa Bay Rays in game five of the 2026 World Series at Tropicana Field. Mandatory Credit: Kim Klement Neitzel-Imagn Images Murphy clarified that the comment stemmed from a running private joke he shared with Bauers about the free agency process. He explained that he brought up New York simply because Bauers had previously played for the Yankees, and admitted he wished the exchange had stayed private. His point was about how large player contracts can make it harder to keep a clubhouse united, not an attack on the Yankees’ 2026 team. item.title: Casey, Jansen and Timoney start against Argentina
item.description: Ireland resume their Nations Championship campaign against Argentina in Dublin on Friday night [Getty Images] Nick Timoney, Craig Casey and Sean Jansen will start for Ireland against Argentina in the Nations Championship on Friday night, with Jamison Gibson-Park and Josh van der Flier on the bench at Aviva Stadium. With captain Caelan Doris and two-tour British and Irish Lion Jack Conan missing through injury, Connacht's Jansen always seemed the most likely to fill in at number eight for head coach Andy Farrell. The 27-year-old made a try-scoring debut for Ireland against Japan in July and followed that with a cameo as a replacement against the All Blacks a week later. The selections of Casey and Timoney, however, were less expected. Influential scrum-half Gibson-Park has arguably been Ireland's best performer in recent seasons. The 34-year-old missed the start of Leinster's season with a groin injury but made his return in the win over Munster on 24 October. With only that game under his belt this season, he will start on the bench with Casey preferred to start at nine in a half-back partnership with fly-half Sam Prendergast, who has recovered from a wrist injury. Ulster back row Timoney, 31, previously struggled to regularly break into the side despite strong form for his province, but selection against Argentina means he will be involved in his ninth consecutive Test. Seven of those appearances, however, have been from the bench and his start on Friday night comes at the expense of former World Rugby player of the year Van der Flier. With Garry Ringrose ruled out because of a hamstring problem, the experienced Robbie Henshaw will wear the 13 jersey, forming a midfield partnership with Stuart McCloskey. Wing Mack Hansen, prop Andrew Porter and Ryan Baird all start, having not featured for Ireland since the defeat by South Africa in November 2025. All three missed the Six Nations and summer fixtures in the Nations Championship through injury. Hansen starts in the number 11 jersey in what is Ireland's first home game since James Lowe's departure from Irish rugby, with Robert Baloucoune keeping his spot on the right wing and Hugo Keenan selected at full-back. Baird is selected at blind-side flanker, joining Timoney and Jansen in the back row. Porter's return at loose-head will be a considerable boost for coach Farrell after recent windows were impact by injury problems at the position. He will pack down alongside hooker Dan Sheehan, who captains the side in Doris' absence, and tight-head Tadhg Furlong. Furlong is free to play after he was cleared by a disciplinary committee of grabbing Gavin Coombes in the groin last month. With Tadhg Beirne and Joe McCarthy selected as starting locks, James Ryan must make do with a place on the bench alongside Van der Flier and Gibson-Park. Sam Illo, who will make his home debut if called upon, Ronan Kelleher, Tom O'Toole, Ciaran Frawley and Bundee Aki are Ireland's other replacements. Argentina boss Felipe Conte

item.title: Conor McGregor dismisses ‘false’ & ‘edited’ video from RAF-Hype Italy event

item.title: Afghanistan vs. Zimbabwe prediction, team news, pitch report and betting tips for 1st Test
item.description: Afghanistan and Zimbabwe meet in Sharjah on Thursday, November 5 (11.30 a.m. IST) for the first of two Tests, on a ground that has not staged the format in a decade. The last one, in 2016, ended with West Indies chasing 154 against Pakistan. Since then, Sharjah has hosted 76 men's white-ball games and earned a name for slow, low-bouncing pitches and a sluggish outfield, with temperatures above 36 degrees forecast. Zimbabwe are likely to give a debut to Antum Naqvi, the Belgian-born batter with six hundreds in 24 first-class matches. Brian Bennett captains because Richard Ngarava has a back problem, and Sikandar Raza is missing. Afghanistan are without Rashid Khan, Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Ibrahim Zadran, so Rahmat Shah leads a side coming off a draw with Bangladesh in Abu Dhabi. MORE: Virat Kohli vs. Babar Azam: Who is the greatest? Afghanistan vs. Zimbabwe prediction: Who will win? Afghanistan and Zimbabwe have each won two of their five meetings, with one draw, so nothing in the history separates them. Sharjah is the real opponent here. The surface is slow, the bounce is low and the outfield is sluggish, so runs will be hard to come by and the spinners will matter more than the quicks. That helps Afghanistan, who have Qais Ahmed and Zia-ur-Rehman, and it also helps Zimbabwe if Graeme Cremer or Vincent Masekesa play. Zimbabwe's batting is full of experience but short of big names, with Raza missing and a debutant in Naqvi. Afghanistan lack Rashid Khan, Gurbaz and Ibrahim Zadran, yet Rahmat Shah and Hashmatullah Shahidi give them a steadier top order. Afghanistan are also more used to these conditions. item.title: Tigers Trade Proposal Would Send Zach McKinstry to Yankees for Former Top Prospect
item.description: The Detroit Tigers have an interesting decision to make regarding Zach McKinstry this offseason, and a trade idea involving the New York Yankees could give president of baseball operations Scott Harris something to think about. What if Detroit could turn its former All-Star utilityman into one of baseball’s most recognizable former top prospects? That’s the possibility raised by a recent proposal involving Yankees outfielder Jasson Domínguez , the 23-year-old switch-hitter once considered one of the brightest young talents in the game. It’s a deal that would carry considerable risk for both organizations. But with McKinstry coming off a disappointing offensive season and Detroit looking for ways to improve its lineup, the idea deserves a closer look. Jul 30, 2026; Chicago, Illinois, USA; New York Yankees right fielder Jasson Domínguez (24) hits a double against the Chicago White Sox during the sixth inning at Rate Field. Mandatory Credit: David Banks-Imagn Images Credit: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect (Reuters) Tigers-Yankees Trade Proposal Involves Two Intriguing Players In a recent examination of potential Yankees trade targets, SNY identified McKinstry as a possible addition for New York and suggested that Domínguez could be an intriguing player to make available. That creates the foundation for the following hypothetical exchange: Detroit Tigers receive: OF Jasson Domínguez New York Yankees receive: UTIL Zach McKinstry The proposed one-for-one structure is a simplified version of SNY’s broader trade idea, rather than a confirmed offer or an agreed-upon exchange of equal value. There is currently no confirmed report that the Tigers and Yankees have discussed this trade , nor is there evidence that either organization has formally proposed the swap. Still, the concept raises an interesting question. Would Detroit be better off keeping an established defensive specialist or gambling on a younger player who might have considerably more offensive upside? Zach McKinstry’s 2026 Season Changed Everything Just one year ago, McKinstry appeared to have established himself as one of Detroit’s most valuable supporting players. During the 2025 season, he earned his first All-Star selection and captured a Silver Slugger Award while hitting .259 with 12 home runs, 49 RBIs, and a .771 OPS. He provided manager A.J. Hinch with tremendous positional flexibility while contributing enough offensively to remain in the lineup regularly. Then came 2026. McKinstry’s production dropped dramatically. In 129 games, he hit just .199 with four home runs, 26 RBIs, and a .582 OPS. That’s a difficult offensive line to justify for a team trying to improve its scoring production. However, McKinstry continued providing significant defensive value, appearing at multiple positions and earning recognition for his work with the glove. item.title: Brandon Aiyuk files for reinstatement, to be at 49ers facility on Friday
item.description: SANTA CLARA, CALIFORNIA - OCTOBER 20: Brandon Aiyuk #11 of the San Francisco 49ers warms up prior to the start of the game against the Kansas City Chiefs at Levi's Stadium on October 20, 2024 in Santa Clara, California. (Photo by Thearon W. Henderson/Getty Images) | Getty Images In a turn of events, San Francisco 49ers wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk has hired new representation and is filing for reinstatement, according to ESPN’s Adam Schefter. Aiyuk, who has been on the Reserve/Left Squad list all season, recently hired Drew Rosenhaus as his new agent this week, as he looks forward to returning to the football field for the first time in two years. “Wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk has turned in paperwork to be reinstated, per his agent Drew Rosenhaus,” Schefter tweeted. “Aiyuk, who is currently on San Francisco’s Reserve/Left Squad list, will be reporting to the 49ers’ training facility Friday afternoon, per Drew Rosenhaus.” “Brandon is healthy and ready to get back on the field,” Rosenhaus said. This development speeds up San Francisco’s timeline with Aiyuk, as Schefter added that the 49ers now need to keep him (under his current contract), find a trade partner, or release him before Tuesday’s trade deadline. Aiyuk is finally turning things around after a bizarre offseason following his sitting out the entire 2025 campaign after the 49ers voided around $27 million worth of guarantees. He had hinted for much of the offseason that he would sign with the Washington Commanders, even flaunting their gear on social media, while publicly calling out Jayden Daniels. Washington ended up signing wide receiver Stefon Diggs before the season started, ruling out the need for Aiyuk. Following his erratic behavior this offseason, it’s unclear if there’d be any real suitors for Aiyuk this season, but he could have his options in front of him by next Tuesday’s trade deadline following his reinstatement filing.

item.title: Jalen Washington’s eligibility case set to move to Indiana
item.description: Tennessee forward Jalen Washington (9) during an open scrimmage held at Thompson-Boling Arena at Food City Center on Oct. 3, 2026. | USA TODAY Network via Reuters Co Jalen Washington’s attempt to gain eligibility will now move to the state of Indiana, where Washington is originally from. The former North Carolina Tar Heel and Vanderbilt Commodore committed to Tennessee back in the summer, but lost eligibility in August. He lost an appeal last month in the Tennessee Supreme Court. Barnes confirmed what has been talked about for the last few weeks. “We understand they are going to move him to the Indiana case, which has already been resolved for now,” Barnes said on Vol Network after Tennessee’s win over Wofford. “That’s where he’s from. That’s his home state. I would like to think that they see he has got a chance to make some earnings and they will rule in his favor.” The 6-10 power forward averaged 8.9 points and 5.6 rebounds last season for Vanderbilt. He’s seeking a fifth year of eligibility following the NCAA’s new five-for-five rule. Barnes has expressed a need for more depth in Tennessee’s frontcourt, and Washington clearly fits that bill. “He changes our team,” Rick Barnes said in September. “He changed our team once he came on campus. Jalen gives us a real physical presence. He’s improved so many other things with our team. So, he is a difference maker. We had one scholarship left. We were not going to give it to a high school player because we were already into the summer. “But now I think, in my honest opinion, if one (fifth-year) guy is eligible, they should all be eligible. And it won’t play out like that. Probably not.” Tennessee has played DeWayne Brown and Miles Rubin so far in the paint. Jalen Haralson has also gotten plenty of run as a hybrid-four. Braeden Lue is firmly in the rotation, while Christian Fermin provides some depth. It would be interesting to see that pecking order should Washington get cleared.

Off to Spain to catch ‘em all. pic.twitter.com/RLkWSboeRf Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) — Cincinnati Bengals (@Bengals) November 4, 2026 “Off to Spain to catch ’em all,” the Bengals’ caption read. Burrow is a fan of Pokémon, so his outfit for the trip is not surprising. The neck pillow was especially crucial given the length of the flight. Joe Burrow and the Bengals’ Spain game Mandatory Credit: Jamie Sabau-Imagn Images In Week 9, the Bengals will play the Falcons in Spain. The game will be broadcast on NFL Network. Fans on the East Coast will have to wake up early, though, as it begins at 9:30 am EST. The Falcons are coming off an embarrassing 16-0 loss to the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in Week 8. Burrow scored six total touchdowns (five passing and one rushing), though he threw three interceptions. Hopefully, they don’t need the same kind of firepower to win in Week 9. item.title: Merab Dvalishvili books Marlon Moraes rematch for RAF Abu Dhabi on Nov. 14
item.description: Former UFC 135-pound champion Merab Dvalishvili will collide with ex-UFC bantamweight contender Marlon Moraes as part of the upcoming RAF fight card on Nov. 14 in Abu Dhabi . Their bout serves as a rematch from their UFC 266 matchup, which saw “The Machine” unplug Moraes in the second round . Dvalishvili is coming off losses in both RAF and UFC. After getting pinned by Henry Cejudo at RAF 12 back in August, the Georgian came up short in his Petr Yan rematch at UFC 333 , failing to reclaim the 135-pound crown. As for Moraes, who is now a cop in South Florida , he returned to competition last summer with a unanimous decision victory over Maximiliano Perez at LMC 2 in São Paulo, Brazil. “Magic” is three years older than “The Machine” at 38. RAF Abu Dhabi will be headlined by the cruiserweight crossover title fight pitting Khamzat Chimaev against Colby Covington , a bout that lost some of its intrigue after watching “Chaos” embarrass himself against Raul Rosas Jr. earlier this week in Italy. Elsewhere on the RAF Abu Dhabi fight card, Arman Tsarukyan wrestles Neiman Gracie , for some reason.

item.title: Barcelona homegrown star emerges as Flick’s clearest choice to replace injured Rodri
item.description: Barcelona homegrown star emerges as Flick’s clearest choice to replace injured Rodri According to SPORT , Marc Bernal is emerging as the clear favourite to replace Rodri in the Barcelona midfield unit, following the latter’s injury against Aston Villa. The 30-year-old summer signing has been a permanent fixture in the team since his arrival, but suffered a hamstring injury on Tuesday night during the UEFA Champions League clash at the Spotify Camp Nou. Barcelona confirmed Rodri’s injury earlier today, ruling him out of the weekend’s La Liga clash against Atletico Madrid. While the club did not provide a specific timeline for his return, reports suggest that he will be sidelined for a month . Marc Bernal the most likely replacement This leaves Barcelona in a precarious position considering that Rodri has been Flick’s preferred partner for Pedri in the double pivot for much of the season. Rodri out for one month. (Photo by Pedro Salado/Getty Images) Now, as per the report, the evidence from this season strongly suggests that Bernal will be the one taking over as Barcelona’s first-choice defensive midfielder during Rodri’s absence. In the four games when Rodri did not start this term, Bernal was the player chosen to feature in the lineup by Flick. Indeed, Bernal got the nod in Barcelona’s opening La Liga fixture against Elche, when the Spain captain was not in the squad, as well as the games against Athletic Club and Rayo Vallecano and the Champions League meeting with PSG. Overall, Bernal has accumulated 505 minutes across 13 appearances for Barcelona this season, registering two assists in the process. The midfielder averages 34.4 touches per match, completes 88% of his passes and records 2.7 recoveries, 3.2 duels won and 0.9 clearances per game in La Liga this season. Flick has total faith in Bernal Bernal to step in for Rodri. (Photo by David Ramos/Getty Images) Manager Flick has complete and total faith in Bernal’s talent and ability to step up as Barcelona’s starting defensive midfielder. This was pretty much evident from his comments after the 3-0 win over Aston Villa at Camp Nou last night, as he said : “Frenkie’s just come back from injury; he played as a centre-back against Alavés, and Bernal has played very well whenever he’s been on the pitch.” The German tactician has backed the La Masia graduate from the moment he took over the reins at Barcelona back in 2024. And, with Rodri now being out of action for an extended period, Bernal appears to be the next in line to step into the side despite Flick having other options like Gavi and Frenkie de Jong.

item.title: Former Michigan Star Could Become Surprise Lions Trade Target
item.description: The Detroit Lions could have an opportunity to bring a familiar face back to Michigan before the NFL trade deadline. And it’s a player Lions fans probably remember for all the wrong reasons. Mike Sainristil , the former Michigan Wolverines standout who helped end Detroit’s Super Bowl dreams in January 2025, has emerged as a possible trade option as general manager Brad Holmes searches for reinforcements in the secondary. According to NFL insider Albert Breer, Detroit has been exploring the cornerback market ahead of the November 10 deadline, and Sainristil is among the players who could make sense. That’s an intriguing possibility for a Lions defense that needs additional help defending the pass. However, there’s a significant question Holmes would need to answer before making a move. Would Sainristil actually solve Detroit’s biggest problem at cornerback? Nov 1, 2026; Landover, Maryland, USA; Washington Commanders cornerback Mike Sainristil (0) stands on the field during a stoppage in play against the Philadelphia Eagles at Northwest Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Geoff Burke-Imagn Images Credit: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect (Reuters) NFL Insider Identifies Mike Sainristil as Possible Lions Trade Option During his November 3 appearance on The Breer Report , Breer confirmed that Detroit has been searching for cornerback help . The veteran NFL reporter specifically mentioned Sainristil as a potential addition, citing his ability to play both inside and outside. Breer also made an important distinction: Washington has not necessarily decided to trade its former second-round selection. The Commanders have received inquiries about players, and Sainristil’s reduced playing time suggests a trade could be worth exploring. However, no specific offer from Detroit has been reported. Sainristil’s situation has changed considerably since he entered the NFL. Washington selected him 50th overall in the 2024 NFL Draft after an outstanding career at Michigan. He quickly became an important defensive contributor, starting 16 games as a rookie and another 14 in 2025. But 2026 has been a different story. Through seven appearances, Sainristil has started only twice, recording 18 tackles without an interception or pass breakup. His playing time has declined dramatically, culminating in zero defensive snaps during Washington’s November 1 victory over Philadelphia. That’s a remarkable change for a player who looked like a potential long-term cornerstone in Washington’s secondary. Lions Fans Know Exactly What Sainristil Can Do If Brad Holmes needs a reminder of Sainristil’s upside, he only needs to revisit one of the most painful games in recent Lions history. On January 18, 2025, Detroit entered its NFC divisional playoff matchup against Washington with legitimate Super Bowl aspirations. Instead, the Commanders stunned the Lions 45-31 at Ford Field. item.title: Circle (CRCL) Cuts About 5% of Workforce as Q3 Revenue Hits $865M
item.description: Bitcoin Magazine Circle (CRCL) Cuts About 5% of Workforce as Q3 Revenue Hits $865M Circle Internet Group cut about 5% of its workforce in the third quarter, a reduction the USDC issuer disclosed in the footnotes of an earnings report that showed revenue rising 17% to $865 million and net income up 5% to $226 million. The company booked a $9.1 million restructuring charge for the cuts, which it described as “designed to better align our organizational structure with our operating model and strategic priorities.” The charge covered notice-period pay, severance and benefits. Circle did not say how many employees were affected or which teams were hit, and the layoffs did not appear in the release’s list of business highlights. CRCL shares slipped about 1.2% in premarket trading to $74.33 after gaining 4.4% on Tuesday. The stock trades at a fraction of the highs it reached after its June 2025 IPO. A token sale carried the quarter The headline growth masks a softer core. Reserve income, the interest Circle earns on the Treasuries and cash backing USDC, fell 8% from a year earlier to $658 million as the reserve return rate dropped 61 basis points to 3.5%. Average USDC in circulation grew 8% to $73.3 billion, not enough to offset lower yields, and circulation at quarter-end was flat year over year at $73.9 billion. Circle’s share of the fiat-backed stablecoin market slipped to 27%. What filled the gap was a one-time item. Other revenue jumped to $207 million from $29 million, with $182 million of that from the private presale of ARC, the token for Circle’s new Arc blockchain. Strip that out and total revenue would have declined. Adjusted EBITDA of $317 million, up 85%, carries the same presale. The cost side tells the rest. Operating expenses rose 16% to $245 million on higher general and administrative, depreciation, IT and marketing spending, while distribution costs, the fees Circle pays partners such as Coinbase to hold USDC, fell 8% to $409 million. The workforce cut lands as the company builds Arc, integrates a January asset acquisition and prepares to absorb Tazapay. Circle is spending on the next business Circle is paying for growth outside its core product. Arc’s public mainnet launched Sept. 16 with more than 100 institutional builders, and Circle minted the full 10 billion ARC supply, becoming the first public company to issue a network token for its own layer-one chain. It agreed to buy Tazapay, a Singapore cross-border payments platform with more than $25 billion in annualized volume, in a deal expected to close in 2027. Binance, days before its $6.34 billion hack , put $100 million into Circle equity and renewed a USDC distribution partnership. The GENIUS Act takes effect Jan. 18, bringing federal licensing and reserve rules for stablecoin issuers, a regime the Federal Reserve has begun to fill in. Circle has said its stablecoins will qualify. Whether a smaller headcount and a one-time token windfall can bridge the gap until rates stop fall

item.title: 3 Giants-Eagles storylines for Week 9: Can New York handle prosperity?
item.description: J.J. McCarthy | Getty Images The New York Giants head to Lincoln Financial Field, a place that has been a house of horrors for the Giants more than a decade, to face the Philadelphia Eagles on Sunday. The script has been flipped in 2026, with the Giants leading the division, while the reeling Eagles enter the game in last place in the NFC East with a six-game losing streak. Let’s look at some of this week’s storylines. Who’s the bully now? The Giants have not beaten the Eages at Lincoln Financial Field since a 15-7 victory on Nov. 27, 2013. The Eagles have won the NFC East title three of the last four seasons, appearing in two Super Bowls and winning one. The Giants went 11-38 from 2023-2025. Yet, at the midway point of this season we are living in an alternate reality. The Giants are leading the division at 4-2-1 and trying to make moves to improve their chances of reaching the playoffs. They are the betting favorite. The Eagles are trying to figure out what truck ran them over and whether or not Humpty Dumpty can be put back together again. It is an amazing turn of events. Question is, can and will the Giants handle their business? Good teams win games like this one. Who’s toting the rock? Tyrone Tracy is on injured reserve with a hamstring injury. Cam Skattebo did not practice on Monday due to his own hamstring injury, and head coach John Harbaugh said Skattebo will be “day to day up to the game.” As of this writing, the Giants have not completed a trade for Jonathan Taylor, Derrick Henry, Tony Pollard, Breece Hall , or any other running back. Najee Harris is somewhere looking for a new job. Devin Singletary , who has 18 carries this season, might be the last man standing from the Giants’ original backfield on Sunday. Gregory Desrosiers will be playing in his first NFL game after being signed off the Los Angeles Chargers practice squad. Practice squad back Phil Mafah has five NFL carries. Eric Gray , released in cuts to the 53-man roster, was just re-signed to the practice squad. He has six fumbles in 81 career touches, hardly a confidence-inspring statistic. Can J.J. keep rolling? J.J. McCarthy has played five excellent quarters of football since replacing Jameis Winston in the fourth quarter of a Week 6 loss to the New Orleans Saints. He has fans and media members alike conjuring McCarthy vs. Jaxson Dart scenarios regarding who will quarterback the Giants next season. There is a long way to go, though, and McCarthy has a lot to prove before putting the Giants into a situation where they would actually have to make such a decision. Can McCarthy continue to impress? Can he continue to look like a viable NFL starting quarterback? Can he continue to make the Minnesota Vikings silly for dumping him earlier this season in return for the bargain price of a fifth-round pick? That is to be determined. McCarthy is actually 7-4 as a starting quarterback with five consecutive victories. The common denominator in all of those games? Just like his nationa

item.title: Sinners & Saints: Manchester United 3, Roma 2
item.description: MANCHESTER, ENGLAND - NOVEMBER 03: Gian Piero Gasperini, Manager of AS Roma, reacts during the UEFA Champions League 2026/27 League Phase MD4 match between Manchester United and AS Roma at Old Trafford on November 03, 2026 in Manchester, England. (Photo by Carl Recine/Getty Images) | Getty Images Another night on the European stage, another heart-breaking collapse. While it wasn’t exactly the same as their 4-3 defeat to Real Madrid last month, Tuesday’s 3-2 loss at Old Trafford shared many of the same hallmarks: Roma built an early lead and seemed poised to blow the barn doors off, only to let victory slip through their fingers because of poor execution, lapses in concentration, questionable subs, and, at least in yesterday’s result, shoddy refereeing. After racing to a 2-0 lead in the 18th minute, Roma was poised to compound Michael Carrick’s misery and doom the Red Devils to yet another early-season defeat. However, instead of seizing the chance to climb the Champions League ladder, the Giallorossi stumbled in the second half. After conceding a questionable penalty in the 58th minute (more on that in a moment), Gasperini’s group completely buckled, losing the lead and eventually the match to a Matheus Cunha brace in the 83rd and 86th minutes. Given the result and everything that preceded it, today’s Sinners & Saints won’t be quite as chipper, but we’ll start with a pair of bright spots. The Saints Matías Soulé Before the second half swoon, yesterday’s trip to Old Trafford was shaping up to be a personal showcase for Matías Soulé. Largely unknown to the Premiership-consuming world, Soulé was the star of the show early in the first half, giving Roma the early lead in the 11th minute thanks to a well-struck shot in the middle of the box. Apart from his goal, Soulé spent most of the evening racing up and down the right flank, recovering six balls, playing five passes into the final third, and completing five line-breaking passes. It wasn’t his most statistically impressive performance of the season, but Soulé didn’t falter under the bright lights of the Theatre of Dreams. Rodrigo Mora For 45 minutes, the mop-topped 19-year-old Portuguese midfielder delivered the kind of performance that made you think, “Oh shit, United is going to pay €80 million for him at half-time, aren’t they?” In that time, Mora was arguably the best player on the pitch, creating three scoring chances, completing 90% of his passes (including all long attempts), recovering four balls, and playing four line-breaking passes. item.title: I’ll end insecurity, hunger, make Nigeria affordable — Atiku, launches campaign
item.description: By Musa Ubandawaki, Sokoto Presidential candidate of the African Democratic Congress (ADC), Atiku Abubakar, has pledged to tackle insecurity, hunger and the rising cost of living if elected president in the 2027 general elections. Atiku made the pledge on Wednesday in a statement posted on his X platform while announcing the launch of his presidential campaign in Sokoto State. The former Vice-President said Nigerians were tired of hunger, fear and what he described as broken promises, adding that his campaign would offer a plan to address the country’s challenges. “Sokoto, I am here! I am deeply grateful for the rousing welcome as I formally launch my campaign for the presidency from this historic seat of faith, scholarship, and leadership,” he said. He pledged to end insecurity across the country, restore hope to young people and make Nigeria affordable again. “Nigerians are tired of hunger, fear, and broken promises. Today, they have a choice, a plan, and a leader ready to deliver. I will end the insecurity that haunts our communities, restore hope to our young people, and make Nigeria affordable again,” Atiku said. He described the Sokoto campaign launch as the beginning of what he called a journey to rescue Nigeria, urging supporters to unite behind his presidential ambition. “The journey to rescue Nigeria begins here. Together, we will win,” he added. The post I’ll end insecurity, hunger, make Nigeria affordable — Atiku, launches campaign appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Mitchell Robinson injury scare, new starters, no excuses (Celtics Notebook)
item.description: Mitchell Robinson didn’t play Sunday in Orlando, but that wasn’t injury-related and he was unavailable for rest. Still, when Robinson headed to the locker room late in the first quarter Monday against the Rockets , there was an injury scare. Fortunately, it didn’t end up anything serious. Robinson suffered a left thumb sprain but quickly returned to the game. The Celtics lost 109-93 to the Rockets as they looked gassed, but they didn’t pick up any injury issues from the game. Robinson gave an update on his thumb after the game. “It was on an offensive rebound,” Robinson said, via NBC Sports Boston. “I think it just jammed or something like that. I’m straight.” Robinson finished with four points and four rebounds in his 15 minutes Monday. It’s clear that his offensive rebounding prowess hasn’t quite translated to his short time in Boston. C’s coach Joe Mazzulla pointed out how they’re having him in more actions offensively, meaning he’s not as close to the bucket. RELATED : Expert release Celtics vs. Bucks prediction as Tatum and George headline latest Polymarket props Still, it’s something “I gotta figure it out soon,” Robinson said. He’s still learning how to play with his teammates, and it’s evident they’re still figuring out how best to utilize Robinson. At some point, the Celtics will need him to be the beast on the glass that he’s been throughout his career. “It’s new, but at the end of the day, it’s still basketball,” Robinson said. “Things that I do naturally, I should still be doing. I don’t know. I just haven’t found my rhythm yet.” Look at the starters Robinson was available Monday, but the Celtics went with a different starting lineup. Neemias Queta got the start for the second straight game, and this time it was noteworthy because Robinson also could’ve started. Instead, Queta got the nod. Elsewhere, Hugo Gonzalez got his second straight start, as well. He replaced Jordan Walsh, who started the first five games of the year, in a different wrinkle. Baylor Scheierman also joined the starting group, though he did so because Paul George was out Monday for rest. Mazzulla doesn’t put a ton of stock into the starters, but it’s still something worth monitoring throughout the season. He pointed out how they went back to Robinson starting the second half Monday, though that was in a double big lineup look that also featured Queta. “Just taking advantage of our depth, taking advantage of our variety,” Mazzulla said. “Had guys in different roles be able to play in different ways. I put just as much weight into every single lineup as that one. Changed the lineup at halftime. He started the second half. That’s kind of how we do it.” No excuses The Celtics looked gassed by the time the Rockets pulled away in the fourth quarter, building up a lead that peaked at 18 points. The C’s never put together a comeback attempt that threatened the result, though they certainly tried. But on the second game of a back-to-back, they didn’t have the juice. But Jay

item.title: Diogo Dalot insists Man United's dramatic comeback against Roma can 'change season'
item.description: Diogo Dalot believes Manchester United 's dramatic Champions League comeback against Roma can change their season. United trailed by two goals at Old Trafford on Tuesday before winning a memorable European tie 3-2. Bruno Fernandes ' retaken penalty started the recovery, with a last-gasp Matheus Cunha brace and an even later red card completing a spectacular fightback by Michael Carrick 's side. Roma had raced into a deserved two-goal lead, and a United side in the midst of a nine-match winless run had looked set to see that sequence reach double figures. That barren spell includes poor Premier League performances, and the Red Devils' worst start to a league campaign since 1986 which has left them 17th, just above the relegation zone on goal difference. Reflecting on Tuesday’s win, Dalot said: "I think a really good second half. I think we came with the right attitude. Matheus Cunha scored twice to win the game for Man United (Reuters) "We did pretty much everything that we needed to do to turn the game on and it's moments like this, it's nights like this that can change momentum, and hopefully we can change ours. Not just the manager, everyone is under pressure. "When you don't win games for this football club, every moment, every person, everyone involved gets under pressure, and we felt it obviously, because we're not near good enough of what we should have done. “And, like I said, nights like this can change momentum, can change seasons, and I think this win is going to give us confidence for the next games.” Attention now turns to Aston Villa's visit to Old Trafford, where United will attempt to follow up the Roma turnaround by winning their second Premier League match of the season. A victory on Sunday would be huge for all connected to the club ahead of the international break, while further disappointment would darken the mood and raise major questions over Carrick's future. “These moments are really tough, I’m not going to lie,” Dalot said. "Unfortunately, I've had a few moments like this in the past, and the only way for us to get out is by winning football games. I think that's the only way you can get confidence. Michael Carrick is still facing an uncertain future despite Tuesday’s win (PA) "And nights like this, like I've said, give you an extra confidence that make you believe that you can create these moments, not just for us, but for the fans. “And it’s important from everyone around the club feeling that we care, that we want to turn this around, and I think we’ve showed, especially in the second 45 minutes, that we really want to turn this around.” Dalot's view is that the head start United gave Roma left Carrick's side with “nothing more to lose”, and Villa cannot be handed the same early advantage. “That’s the unfortunate situation that we are in, so we just had to really go at it,” he said of the second half. “I think that the biggest thing that we need to get out of this game today is when we play like this, when you have the

item.title: Blake Griffin frustrated after paying more than NBA tickets to watch his son play
item.description: Kirby Lee-Imagn Images Blake Griffin frustrated after paying more than NBA tickets to watch his son play appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The costs and pressure surrounding youth sports are going to another level, with Blake Griffin raising concerns after an expensive weekend at his son’s basketball tournament. The former NBA star was surprised by how much he had to spend just to watch his child compete. “I was at my son’s basketball tournament this past weekend, and I paid $80 for a wristband to watch my own kid play and $60 to park for the weekend,” Griffin said on The Stepback Show . “That’s on top of everything else. You can see NBA games for that much, sometimes less.” Blake Griffin says youth basketball has changed for the worse after paying $140 just to watch his own son play, more than some NBA games Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) “I was at my son’s basketball tournament this past weekend, and I paid $80 for a wristband to watch my own kid play, and $60 to park for the… pic.twitter.com/3QK87uPCfS — katsu (@katsuxbt) November 3, 2026 Additionally, Griffin noticed how parents behaved toward referees and questioned how much youth basketball has changed since he was growing up. “I realized as I was watching my son play, or actually, as I was watching parents berate a poor referee, that something has changed from when I was a kid, and I don’t think it’s for the better.” He believes the current environment is moving in the wrong direction. Griffin discussed how youth sports have become increasingly commercialized, with families encouraged to commit their children to one sport throughout the year. The practice, known as early sports specialization, was also discussed by LeBron James and Steve Nash on an episode of Mind the Game. Nash recalled a time when children could participate in different sports across seasons without the financial pressure of year-round programs. James agreed with his concerns, calling early specialization “the worst thing you can do.” Griffin then used one of James’ most recognizable moments to make his point. “Do you know how bad something has to be for LeBron James to call it the worst thing you can do?” Griffin joked, referencing the famous 2018 NBA Finals moment when James reacted to J.R. Smith failing to shoot after an offensive rebound. item.title: Senate to suspend bills for new universities in line with FG policy
item.description: The Senate has directed its committees and the Clerk to suspend the processing of bills seeking the establishment of new universities and other tertiary institutions, in line with the Federal Government’s policy. Senate Leader, Opeyemi Bamidele, announced the directive during plenary on Wednesday, urging lawmakers to respect the government’s decision to halt the establishment of additional tertiary institutions. Bamidele said the policy was aimed at strengthening existing universities and other institutions before considering the creation of new ones. He urged the Clerk of the Senate to inform lawmakers about the directive and advised relevant committees, particularly those on education, against presenting bills for new institutions for consideration. He acknowledged that lawmakers sometimes found it difficult to reject requests from colleagues seeking support for the establishment of universities and other tertiary institutions. Supporting the directive, Senate President Godswill Akpabio said President Bola Tinubu had discussed the matter with the leadership of the National Assembly and expressed opposition to establishing new universities, polytechnics and other tertiary institutions for the next five to seven years. According to Akpabio, the moratorium would give existing institutions time to develop their infrastructure and commence effective academic operations. He noted that some recently established universities existed largely on paper, with several yet to acquire permanent sites or complete necessary site-clearance processes. The Senate President stressed that establishing a university was a major national responsibility, noting that such institutions should not be created with the same ease as primary schools. He added that universities were national institutions expected to admit students from across the country, regardless of their geographical locations. Akpabio said the Federal Government had made efforts to ensure the geographical spread of universities across the country, making it important to consolidate existing investments. He consequently directed the Clerk to ensure that bills seeking the establishment of new tertiary institutions were no longer listed for consideration. The Senate adjourned plenary until November 10, 2026, at 11 a.m. (NAN) The post Senate to suspend bills for new universities in line with FG policy appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: 2027: ADC urges Nigerians to replicate US voters’ revolt against ruling party
item.description: By Luminous Jannamike ABUJA – The African Democratic Congress, ADC, has urged Nigerians to take a cue from American voters by using the 2027 general elections to reject the ruling All Progressives Congress, APC, over economic hardship, worsening insecurity and declining living standards. The party said Tuesday’s US midterm elections had demonstrated that no government could take voters for granted, insisting that Nigerians must put their welfare above political loyalty, sentiments and personality politics when deciding who governs them. In a statement by its National Publicity Secretary, Mallam Bolaji Abdullahi, the ADC described the American election outcome as a decisive rebuke of the ruling Republican Party’s leadership and economic policies, saying it offered an important lesson for Nigeria’s democracy. “Americans have shown that when politicians become arrogant, when policies punish ordinary people, and when those in power mistake popularity for a permanent licence to govern, the ballot box remains the ultimate instrument of accountability,” the party said. The opposition party said Nigerians had endured years of economic hardship and worsening insecurity under the President Bola Tinubu-led APC administration, questioning why the ruling party should be rewarded with another mandate. “We cannot continue to complain about the cost of living while voting for a President who has made life unaffordable. We cannot demand security while rewarding failure. We cannot earnestly yearn for change while sustaining the very political system responsible for our collective impoverishment,” the ADC said. Urging Nigerians to mobilise ahead of 2027, the party called for massive voter turnout, describing the Permanent Voter Card as an instrument for changing the country’s political direction. “History beckons in 2027. Our voters’ cards must become instruments of change, not souvenirs of citizenship. Nigerians must turn out massively and vote for their own interests,” Abdullahi said. The party also unveiled its campaign message, presenting itself and its candidates as an alternative to the APC-led government. “The ADC and its candidates are offering Nigerians a clear alternative: Make Nigeria Affordable Again. Make Nigeria Safe Again. Give Nigerians Jobs Again,” the statement said. Drawing a direct parallel with the American elections, Abdullahi urged Nigerians to make their votes count in 2027, warning that the APC should not mistake its hold on power for a permanent mandate. “If Americans can use their votes to demand better, Nigerians can do the same. In 2027, let our votes speak louder than the APC-induced suffering,” he said. The post 2027: ADC urges Nigerians to replicate US voters’ revolt against ruling party appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Photos: ADC supporters rally in large numbers for campaign flag-off in Sokoto
item.description: By Musa Ubandawaki, Sokoto The slogan “Tinubu Must Go” reverberated across the venue of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) presidential campaign flag-off along Illorin Road in Sokoto metropolis on Wednesday, as supporters of the opposition party expressed their opposition to President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s administration ahead of the 2027 general elections. The slogan, which became a recurring chant among the crowd, reflected the determination of ADC supporters to mobilise Nigerians for political change and challenge the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) at the polls. The chant gained momentum as supporters, many of whom had travelled from different parts of Sokoto State, expressed solidarity with the ADC and its presidential candidate, former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar. The rally also provided an opportunity for supporters to express dissatisfaction with the Tinubu administration, particularly over the economic challenges confronting Nigerians and persistent security concerns affecting communities across the country. The development highlighted the ADC’s efforts to strengthen its support base in Sokoto State and mobilise grassroots support ahead of the 2027 general elections. As the party intensifies its nationwide mobilisation, the rally offered a platform for opposition supporters to communicate their grievances and demand political change. However, as of the time of filing this report, the ADC presidential campaign train was yet to arrive at the venue from the Sultan Abubakar III International Airport, Sokoto, reportedly due to the large crowd along the route. item.title: 2027: No coalition needed in Ondo, APC elders declare
item.description: Target one million votes for Tinubu, 80% turnout By Dayo Johnson, Akure The PBAT Mandate Elders Forum (PMF), Ondo State chapter, has declared that there is no need for a coalition arrangement in the state ahead of the 2027 general elections, insisting that the All Progressives Congress (APC) is strong enough to win all elective positions. The Forum also set a target of at least one million votes for President Bola Tinubu’s re-election, alongside an 80 per cent voter turnout in the state. The position was made known at a meeting of the Forum in Akure, the state capital, where its chairman, Hon. Demola Ijabiyi, said the APC’s dominance in the state made any arrangement requiring it to surrender candidates or constituencies unnecessary. Ijabiyi said the Forum recognised the importance of cooperation among political parties with shared political objectives but maintained that such arrangements must reflect the political realities of individual states. “In Ondo State, the APC is the dominant political party, controlling government at both the state and local government levels,” he said. He said the Forum welcomed support from other political parties for Tinubu’s re-election but would not accept any arrangement that required APC candidates to step down. “Support for the President need not depend on displacing APC candidates. We have confidence in our candidates and their prospects of victory,” he said. According to him, coalition arrangements are more appropriate in states where political parties have limited electoral strength and need to combine forces to overcome their weaknesses. He explained that parties could support stronger candidates in constituencies where they lacked sufficient electoral strength in exchange for reciprocal support elsewhere. “But we don’t have that kind of circumstance in Ondo State. There is no constituency that we cannot win. There is no constituency that we do not want to contest. We are going to win all. That is the bottom line,” he said. The Forum chairman also cited the declining political strength of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP), which he described as the major opposition party in the state in the past, as another reason the APC should not surrender its electoral interests. On mobilisation, Ijabiyi said the Forum was working towards extending its structures to every ward and polling unit to mobilise voters and secure victory for Tinubu and all APC candidates. He said Ondo State’s more than two million registered voters ahead of the 2027 governorship election presented a significant electoral opportunity, adding that the challenge was to translate the figure into actual voter participation. “We have therefore set a voter turnout target of at least 80 per cent. The PMF will work towards this through sustained mobilisation and voter education. Alongside this, we must earn sufficient support to deliver at least one million votes for the President,” he said. item.title: Bitcoin Price Soars Above $79,000 After Democratic Sweep of Congress
item.description: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Soars Above $79,000 After Democratic Sweep of Congress Bitcoin price traded near $79,200 on Wednesday morning, up about 2% on the day, after Democrats won control of both the House and the Senate in Tuesday’s midterm elections and dealt the crypto industry its worst night in Washington since 2022. The Associated Press called the Senate for Democrats late Tuesday and the House early Wednesday. House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries is in line to become speaker. The result exceeded most forecasts: by Wednesday morning the AP tracker showed Democrats with 54 Senate seats to Republicans’ 44, with races still open. Prediction markets had put a Democratic House above 90% for weeks, but the Senate margin and the loss of several Republican crypto allies in the House came as a surprise. The bitcoin price reacted in two moves. Bitcoin fell to $75,618, a seven-week low, as results came in during Asian trading, then recovered the full loss and more by the European open. Traders broadly speaking treated the sweep as the removal of a known risk rather than a shock: prediction markets had priced a Democratic win for weeks, and options desks saw heavy call buying on election day, with block volume more than double the prior session. The view on the desks is that a Democratic Congress is less friendly to crypto legislation but that divided government, a presidential veto and executive orders cap how much policy can change, leaving technical targets near $82,000 as the next test. Demand remains the weak point, with U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs shedding about $1.16 billion over three sessions and the price still about 27% below where it stood a year ago, down from about $80,500 a week before the vote. The races that cost bitcoin and crypto The industry’s super PACs spent more than $170 million this cycle, most of it for Republicans, and the headline bets failed. Sherrod Brown won back an Ohio Senate seat in a special election against Sen. Jon Husted despite about $64 million in crypto money aimed at stopping him, the largest sum the industry has spent against any single candidate. Brown chaired the Senate Banking Committee until his 2024 defeat and spent that tenure resisting market structure bills. Senate seniority rules may limit his path back to a gavel, but he returns to a chamber his party controls. Three House Republicans the industry counted on lost their seats: Bryan Steil of Wisconsin, who fell to ER nurse Mitchell Berman; Zach Nunn of Iowa; and Ann Wagner of Missouri. Stand With Crypto had endorsed Steil and Nunn and directed ad money to both. Mike Lawler of New York conceded to Democrat Cait Conley with the race uncalled. House Financial Services Chairman French Hill appears to have held his Arkansas seat but will hand the gavel to Rep. Maxine Waters.
